Angel Adaptive · full-page before / after · part 1 of 4

The real engine adapting live pages — whole start page + pricing page, before & after

Each site was re-crawled live, the engine (adaptive-lab.js, v0.13) injected, and the whole page photographed before → adapting → after, then reverted to confirm it comes back clean. HOME adapts for an engaged reader (trust bar of proof not already shown, CTA emphasis, reorder where eligible); PRICING adapts for a price-hesitant visitor (spotlight the plans, surface a refund/guarantee). Scroll a pane — before & after scroll together. "After" is the engine's safe primitives, not the Claude cohort redesign (that needs the prod API).
